```{r}
drivers <- read.csv("DRIVERS.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
vehicles <- read.csv("VEHICLES.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
tires <- read.csv("TIRES.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
gliders <- read.csv("GLIDERS.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
records <- read.csv("mario_kart_records_cleaned.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

```{r}
records$Character <- trimws(records$Character)
records$Vehicle <- trimws(records$Vehicle)
records$Tires <- trimws(records$Tires)
records$Glider <- trimws(records$Glider)

character_counts <- records %>%
  count(Character, sort = TRUE) %>%
  rename(Count = n)

combinations_counts <- records %>%
  group_by(Character, Vehicle, Tires, Glider) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), AvgScore = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  arrange(desc(Count))

score_stats <- records %>%
  summarise(
    MinScore = min(Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    MaxScore = max(Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    AvgScore = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    MedianScore = median(Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(head(character_counts, 20), aes(x = reorder(Character, Count), y = Count)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top 20 Popular Character ",
       x = "Character", 
       y = "Number") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("character_frequency.png", width = 10, height = 8)
```

```{r}
top_combinations <- head(combinations_counts, 10)
top_combinations$Combination <- paste(top_combinations$Character, 
                                      top_combinations$Vehicle, 
                                      top_combinations$Tires, 
                                      top_combinations$Glider, 
                                      sep = " + ")

ggplot(top_combinations, aes(x = reorder(Combination, Count), y = Count)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "世界纪录中最常用的组合（前10名）",
       x = "组合", 
       y = "纪录数量") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))

ggsave("top_combinations.png", width = 12, height = 8)
```

```{r}
plot_attribute_distribution <- function(dataset, title) {
  attributes <- c("GroundSpeed", "WaterSpeed", "AirSpeed", "AntiGravitySpeed", 
                  "Acceleration", "Weight", "GroundHandling", "WaterHandling", 
                  "AirHandling", "AntiGravityHandling", "Traction", "MiniTurbo")

  long_data <- dataset %>%
    select(c(2, all_of(attributes))) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(attributes), 
                 names_to = "Attribute", 
                 values_to = "Value")
  

  ggplot(long_data, aes(x = Attribute, y = Value)) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "skyblue") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(title = paste("Attribute Distributions -", title),
         y = "Value", x = "Attribute")
}

p1 <- plot_attribute_distribution(drivers, "Drivers")
p2 <- plot_attribute_distribution(vehicles, "Vehicles")
p3 <- plot_attribute_distribution(tires, "Tires")
p4 <- plot_attribute_distribution(gliders, "Gliders")

grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, ncol = 2)
ggsave("attribute_distributions.png", width = 12, height = 10)
```

```{r}
driver_names <- drivers$Driver
vehicle_names <- vehicles$Vehicle
tire_names <- tires$Tire
glider_names <- gliders$Glider

combinations <- expand.grid(
  Driver = driver_names,
  Vehicle = vehicle_names,
  Tire = tire_names,
  Glider = glider_names
)

get_attributes <- function(component_name, dataset, name_col) {
  idx <- which(dataset[[name_col]] == component_name)
  if (length(idx) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  attributes <- c("GroundSpeed", "WaterSpeed", "AirSpeed", "AntiGravitySpeed", 
                  "Acceleration", "Weight", "GroundHandling", "WaterHandling", 
                  "AirHandling", "AntiGravityHandling", "Traction", "MiniTurbo")
  
  return(as.numeric(dataset[idx, attributes]))
}

# 函数：计算组合的属性总和
calculate_combined_attributes <- function(driver, vehicle, tire, glider) {
  driver_attr <- get_attributes(driver, drivers, "Driver")
  vehicle_attr <- get_attributes(vehicle, vehicles, "Vehicle")
  tire_attr <- get_attributes(tire, tires, "Tire")
  glider_attr <- get_attributes(glider, gliders, "Glider")
  
  # 属性求和
  combined_attr <- driver_attr + vehicle_attr + tire_attr + glider_attr
  
  # 返回为命名向量
  attributes <- c("GroundSpeed", "WaterSpeed", "AirSpeed", "AntiGravitySpeed", 
                  "Acceleration", "Weight", "GroundHandling", "WaterHandling", 
                  "AirHandling", "AntiGravityHandling", "Traction", "MiniTurbo")
  names(combined_attr) <- attributes
  
  return(combined_attr)
}

set.seed(123)
sample_size <- 5000  # 使用较小的样本量加速计算
sampled_combinations <- combinations[sample(nrow(combinations), sample_size), ]

# 计算属性
combinations_with_attributes <- sampled_combinations %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    attrs = list(calculate_combined_attributes(Driver, Vehicle, Tire, Glider))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 将列表列转换为单独的列
attributes <- c("GroundSpeed", "WaterSpeed", "AirSpeed", "AntiGravitySpeed", 
                "Acceleration", "Weight", "GroundHandling", "WaterHandling", 
                "AirHandling", "AntiGravityHandling", "Traction", "MiniTurbo")

for (attr in attributes) {
  combinations_with_attributes[[attr]] <- sapply(combinations_with_attributes$attrs, function(x) x[attr])
}

# 删除列表列
combinations_with_attributes <- combinations_with_attributes %>% select(-attrs)

# 添加组合ID以便于引用
combinations_with_attributes$CombinationID <- 1:nrow(combinations_with_attributes)
```


```{r}
track_types <- tibble(
  TrackType = c("SpeedTrack", "HandlingTrack", "BalancedTrack", "WaterTrack", "AirTrack", "AntiGravityTrack"),
  Description = c(
    "Track with long straight sections: Speed",
    "Track with multiple sharp turns: Handle",
    "Track with mixed elements",
    "Track with extensive water sections",
    "Track with multiple jumps and gliding sections",
    "Track with anti-gravity sections"
  )
)

track_weights <- tibble(
  TrackType = track_types$TrackType,
  GroundSpeed = c(0.3, 0.1, 0.2, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1),
  WaterSpeed = c(0.05, 0.05, 0.1, 0.3, 0.05, 0.05),
  AirSpeed = c(0.05, 0.05, 0.1, 0.05, 0.3, 0.05),
  AntiGravitySpeed = c(0.05, 0.05, 0.1, 0.05, 0.05, 0.3),
  Acceleration = c(0.1, 0.15, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1),
  Weight = c(0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05),
  GroundHandling = c(0.1, 0.25, 0.1, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05),
  WaterHandling = c(0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.2, 0.05, 0.05),
  AirHandling = c(0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.2, 0.05),
  AntiGravityHandling = c(0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.2),
  Traction = c(0.1, 0.1, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05),
  MiniTurbo = c(0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05)
)
```


```{r}
set.seed(123) 

# 函数：根据赛道类型计算组合的性能得分
calculate_performance <- function(combo_row, track_type) {
  # 获取此赛道类型的属性权重
  weights <- track_weights %>% 
    filter(TrackType == track_type) %>% 
    select(-TrackType) %>% 
    as.numeric()
  
  # 获取该组合的属性
  attributes <- combo_row %>% 
    select(all_of(names(track_weights)[-1])) %>% 
    as.numeric()
  
  # 计算加权和
  score <- sum(attributes * weights)
  
  # 添加一些随机噪声（模拟玩家技能、运气等）
  score <- score + rnorm(1, 0, 0.5)
  
  return(score)
}

# 为每个组合在每种赛道类型上生成性能数据
performance_data <- expand.grid(
  CombinationID = combinations_with_attributes$CombinationID,
  TrackType = track_types$TrackType
)

# 与组合数据合并
performance_data <- performance_data %>%
  left_join(combinations_with_attributes, by = "CombinationID")

# 计算性能得分
performance_data <- performance_data %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    PerformanceScore = calculate_performance(cur_data(), TrackType)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

```


```{r}
set.seed(456)
sampled_combinations_for_model <- sample(unique(performance_data$CombinationID), 500)
model_data <- performance_data %>% 
  filter(CombinationID %in% sampled_combinations_for_model)

# 将分类变量编码为整数，供Stan使用
driver_mapping <- data.frame(
  Driver = unique(model_data$Driver),
  DriverID = 1:length(unique(model_data$Driver))
)

vehicle_mapping <- data.frame(
  Vehicle = unique(model_data$Vehicle),
  VehicleID = 1:length(unique(model_data$Vehicle))
)

tire_mapping <- data.frame(
  Tire = unique(model_data$Tire),
  TireID = 1:length(unique(model_data$Tire))
)

glider_mapping <- data.frame(
  Glider = unique(model_data$Glider),
  GliderID = 1:length(unique(model_data$Glider))
)

track_mapping <- data.frame(
  TrackType = unique(model_data$TrackType),
  TrackID = 1:length(unique(model_data$TrackType))
)

# 将ID添加到模型数据中
model_data <- model_data %>%
  left_join(driver_mapping, by = "Driver") %>%
  left_join(vehicle_mapping, by = "Vehicle") %>%
  left_join(tire_mapping, by = "Tire") %>%
  left_join(glider_mapping, by = "Glider") %>%
  left_join(track_mapping, by = "TrackType")

# 准备Stan数据
stan_data <- list(
  N = nrow(model_data),
  D = length(unique(model_data$DriverID)),
  V = length(unique(model_data$VehicleID)),
  T = length(unique(model_data$TireID)),
  G = length(unique(model_data$GliderID)),
  R = length(unique(model_data$TrackID)),
  driver = model_data$DriverID,
  vehicle = model_data$VehicleID,
  tire = model_data$TireID,
  glider = model_data$GliderID,
  track = model_data$TrackID,
  score = model_data$PerformanceScore,
  
  # 添加每种组件类型的属性
  K = length(attributes),  # 属性数量
  driver_attr = matrix(0, nrow = length(unique(model_data$DriverID)), ncol = length(attributes)),
  vehicle_attr = matrix(0, nrow = length(unique(model_data$VehicleID)), ncol = length(attributes)),
  tire_attr = matrix(0, nrow = length(unique(model_data$TireID)), ncol = length(attributes)),
  glider_attr = matrix(0, nrow = length(unique(model_data$GliderID)), ncol = length(attributes))
)

# 填充组件属性
for (i in 1:nrow(driver_mapping)) {
  driver_row <- drivers %>% filter(Driver == driver_mapping$Driver[i])
  stan_data$driver_attr[i,] <- as.numeric(driver_row[, attributes])
}

for (i in 1:nrow(vehicle_mapping)) {
  vehicle_row <- vehicles %>% filter(Vehicle == vehicle_mapping$Vehicle[i])
  stan_data$vehicle_attr[i,] <- as.numeric(vehicle_row[, attributes])
}

for (i in 1:nrow(tire_mapping)) {
  tire_row <- tires %>% filter(Tire == tire_mapping$Tire[i])
  stan_data$tire_attr[i,] <- as.numeric(tire_row[, attributes])
}

for (i in 1:nrow(glider_mapping)) {
  glider_row <- gliders %>% filter(Glider == glider_mapping$Glider[i])
  stan_data$glider_attr[i,] <- as.numeric(glider_row[, attributes])
}
```
